crossRefs.note: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk…
I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” says Yahweh.
For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.”
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.
He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;
for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God…

translations.web: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
translations.bsb: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
translations.kjv: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
translations.asv: For he satisfieth the longing soul, And the hungry soul he filleth with good.
